annotations.title: Get Threads profiles, posts and replies

description: Public Threads (by Meta) data from profiles, post links or search words: profile details with followers, bio and links, latest posts with text, images and video, likes, replies, reposts, quotes and shares, and optionally the replies under each post. No login. Useful for social listening, creator research and brand monitoring. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/threads-scraper on your Apify account (about $0.0015 per profile or post, $0.001 per reply; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 100, max 2000). Cost scales with this.

newest_first.description: For searches: newest posts instead of top posts.

posts_per_profile.description: Latest posts to read per profile.

profiles.description: Usernames, profile links or post links, e.g. ["nasa"].

replies_per_post.description: Replies to read under each post (0 = none).

name: get_threads_posts

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Get Threads profiles, posts and replies
